records.Name: OverviewOfProgram2
records.PropertySetConfig:
{"controlWidth":12,"label":"TextBlock1","text":"

Applicants for POC and ESCR grants will be evaluated separately on each scored section of their proposal, as set forth in the AI application and Application Guidelines, and the applicant’s ability to address each of the criteria listed for such section. Consideration will be based on how completely the applicant has provided information requested for the section and how convincingly the applicant has made a case for the commercial opportunity based on the subject technology. Other criteria to be considered by the reviewers are:

  • The novelty of the technology and the approach to solving a problem (meeting a market or industry need),
  • The strength of the technology’s competitive advantage (intellectual property position),
  • The likelihood that a start-up will be created based on thetechnology,
  • The market/commercialization opportunity represented by the
    project, and
  • The team’s ability to carry out the project.
